item.title: Off-Grid Solar Price Drops — week of 2026-05-20
item.description:
Anker's F3800 PLUS dual-battery kits led the board this week — several 7,680Wh configurations cut 20–28%, the deepest being the 16×410W bundle at $6,214 off, down to $15,685. At the top end, Sol-Ark's whole-home EDGE systems shaved $2,500–$4,100, but those are low single-digit percentages on $45K+ builds, so read them as routine repricing, not a real sale. If you're shopping mid-size storage, the Anker cuts are the ones worth acting on.

  • 28% off ($4,147) Anker F3800 PLUS Dual Kits - 7,680Wh / 6,000W/6,000W + 20×200W Rigid Panel + 2×XP… now $10,852
  • 8% off ($4,111) EDGE PLUS 23.8kW — 3×Sol-Ark 15K, 61.44 kWh LiFePO4 now $44,279
  • 20% off ($3,504) Anker F3800 PLUS Dual Kits - 7,680Wh / 6,000W/6,000W + 24×200W Rigid Panel + 4×XP… now $14,045
  • 6% off ($3,000) EDGE PLUS 23.8kW — 3×Sol-Ark 15K, 64 kWh LiFePO4 now $45,879
  • 4% off ($2,500) EDGE MAX 31.7kW — 3×Sol-Ark 18K, 92.16 kWh LiFePO4 now $64,830
  • 66% off ($2,260) Renogy 600W 12V Mono Solar Premium Kit — 60A MPPT Rover + Bluetooth now $1,140
  • 10% off ($2,198) Anker SOLIX E10 DUAL - Whole Home Backup System now $20,399
  • 7% off ($2,000) ELITE PRO 21.1kW — Sol-Ark 18K, 32.2kWh LiFePO4 now $25,489
  • 10% off ($1,999) Anker SOLIX E10 DUAL - Whole Home Backup System now $18,599
